sampler_script:
import hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from cedar_poo_py_test.launch import events
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'.lake/build/wall-startup-sample'; out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
records=[]
for role,source,arguments,expected in [
 ('lean',root/'.lake/build/bin/manifestLifecycleNative',['catalog'],root/'.lake/build/functional-catalog.json'),
 ('rust',root/'rust/target/release/examples/launch_probe',['replay-catalog'],root/'.lake/build/functional-catalog-receipts.json')]:
 executable=out/role;shutil.copyfile(source,executable);executable.chmod(0o755)
 stderr_path=out/f'{role}.stderr';stdout_path=out/f'{role}.stdout';sample_path=out/f'{role}.sample.txt'
 with (root/'.lake/build/functional-catalog.json').open('rb') as inp, stdout_path.open('wb') as stdout,stderr_path.open('wb') as stderr:
  started=time.time_ns(); child=subprocess.Popen([str(executable),*arguments],stdin=inp,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
  sample_started=time.time_ns()
  sampled=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/sample',str(child.pid),'1','1','-mayDie','-file',str(sample_path)],capture_output=True,timeout=15)
  try: child.wait(timeout=120)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
   child.kill();child.wait();raise
 entry,returned=events(stderr_path.read_bytes(),child.pid,child.returncode,0)
 subprocess.run(['cmp',str(stdout_path),str(expected)],check=True)
 records.append({'role':role,'executable_sha256':hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'pid':child.pid,
  'start_unix_ns':started,'sample_start_unix_ns':sample_started,'main_entry':entry,'main_return':returned,
  'sample_returncode':sampled.returncode,'sample_stderr':sampled.stderr.decode(errors='replace'),
  'stdout_sha256':hashlib.sha256(stdout_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'sample_report':str(sample_path),
  'scope':'One intrusive startup-stack diagnostic per role; 1 second at 1 ms; not latency or resource admission'})
 (out/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(role, 'sample',sampled.returncode,'before_main_ms',(entry['unix_ns']-started)/1e6,flush=True)
stack_limitations: One intrusive one-second, one-millisecond sample per role. Debugger synchronization can perturb dyld; sampled frames do not prove the uninstrumented wait service. Raw reports preserved.
